notes: Original text and original audio are authoritative. These are concise teaching prompts for unfamiliar forms in the first reading dialogue, not new translations, recorded words, automatic morphological analysis, or native-speaker certification. Later dialogues still need contextual grammar cue authoring.

lines.cue: Jak się masz? is an informal way to ask how someone is. Learn the complete question together; Cześć is the greeting.
Dziękuję means thank you. Mam się dobrze is a complete first-person reply meaning I am well; notice mam rather than masz.
Jak masz na imię? asks one person for their name informally. Notice masz in the question; the answer uses mam.
Mam na imię… is the answer pattern for My name is…. Replace Andrew with your name when using the expression.

lines.polish: Proszę i dziękuję są bardzo ważne.
lines.cue: This statement joins two polite words with i (and). Są means are, bardzo means very, and ważne describes something important.
Przepraszam means excuse me or sorry. Nie before rozumiem changes I understand to I do not understand.
